main_text.p: tyropolitanus Metropolita & Locumtenens, & Elias piissimus Presbyter & Locumtenens, Cosmas[?] item Apocrisiarius Alexandrini dixere; Hoc Ecclesiasticis Canonibus non adversatur; Nanque Alexandrinus, & Patriarchalis thro-nus Antiochenus, & similiter sancta Civitatis, in quocunque ordine sive seculari, sive clericali invenerint virtute reliquis aliys praestantiorem, ad archieraticam sedem promovere non dedignantur: neque enim ob solos Clericos Christus in terram descendit, neque illis solis virtutis praemia circumduxit, sed universo Christianorum complemento. Hoc itaque si approbatum fuerit receptumque, omnes Archieraticae sedes in desolationem atque interitum abibunt. Potior enim eorum pars, quae apud nostros inclaruit, ex laicali ordine ad Archieraticas sedes evecti sunt. Nos huic assensum praebere non possumus, ne contra nostros Praesules sententiam tulisse deprehendamur: Sancta Synodus dixit; Singulae sedes habent singulares suas proprias consuetudines, neque pro iis cum aliis in controversiam veniendum est, & decertandum. Observat siquidem Romana Ecclesia suas consuetudines, quod & convenit. Observat itidem & Constantinopolitana Ecclesia quasdam suas consuetudines ab antiquo tempore sibi traditas, similiter & throni Orientales. Quare si Romana Ecclesia nunquam ex laico in Praesulem admi-

page.notes: The name at the start of the second line is printed as "Cofmas" or "Cosmas"; I read it as Cosmas but it is doubtful. The first line's word "Tyropolitanus" begins the page as a fragment, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The left edge shows stray marks and fragments of the neighbouring page; these were left out. The word "aliys" is printed as such and kept. Spelling of u/v was normalised as instructed; printed punctuation spacing (for example before commas) was kept only where it did not affect the words.
